question: India had a single representative at the Paris _______ Olympics.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1900**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India's participation in the Olympics:** The **1900 Paris Olympics** marked India's first-ever representation at the Olympic Games. This was a significant milestone in India's sporting history.
 
• **Representative:** India had a single representative at the 1900 Paris Olympics. **Norman Pritchard**, an Anglo-Indian athlete, was the sole participant from India.
 
• **Achievements:** Norman Pritchard won **two silver medals** in athletics – one in the **200 meters sprint** and another in the **200 meters hurdles**. These were India's first Olympic medals.
 
• **Historical Significance:** Norman Pritchard’s accomplishment in 1900 was the beginning of India's journey in the global sporting arena, laying the foundation for future Olympic participation.
 
• **Controversy:** While Norman Pritchard competed under the Indian flag, there has been some debate about his exact representation. However, the International Olympic Committee (IOC) officially credits his medals to India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Norman Pritchard:**

 
 
• **Birth:** Norman Pritchard was born on **23 June 1875**, in Calcutta (now Kolkata), India.
 
• **Career:** Apart from being an athlete, Norman Pritchard later pursued a career in the entertainment industry, becoming an actor in Hollywood under the name **Norman Trevor**.
 
 
 
• **Paris 1900 Olympics:**
 
 
• The **1900 Olympics** were held in Paris as part of the **World's Fair**, and they spanned several months.
 
• This edition of the Olympics featured several unique events and was markedly different from modern Olympic Games in terms of structure and organization.
 
 
 
• **India's Olympic History:**
 
 
• India officially began sending teams to the Olympics in **1920**, starting with the Antwerp Games.
 
• India’s early Olympic success largely came through its **hockey team**, which won multiple gold medals between **1928 and 1956**.
 
 
 
• **Other Options Explained:**
 
 
• **1896:** The first modern Olympics were held in Athens, Greece, but India did not participate.
 
• **1904:** The Olympics were held in St. Louis, USA; India did not participate.
 
• **1908:** The Olympics were held in London, but India did not send a delegation.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **India’s Olympic Medal Tally:**

 
 
• India has won **35 Olympic medals** as of **2023**, including gold, silver, and bronze in various categories.
 
• India’s first team gold medal was won in **1928** in hockey.
 
 
 
• **Evolution of Indian Sports:**
 
 
• India has diversified its participation in sports like **badminton**, **boxing**, **wrestling**, and **shooting** in recent years.
 
• Indian athletes are increasingly making their mark in global competitions, reflecting the country’s growing investment in sports development.
